writingMethod.title: Select Writing Method
writingMethod.featuredDesc: Focus on functional writing modes tailored to your selected topics or keywords.
writingMethod.specificTypesDesc: Structured formats customized for specific writing goals like tutorials, lists, or comparisons.
writingMethod.keywordDrivenDesc: Enter a target keyword and generate SEO-optimized articles centered around it. Rapidly improve site ranking and attract accurate traffic.
writingMethod.topicExpansionDesc: Input any topic or idea in your mind, explore creative possibilities, and automatically generate SEO-optimized content.
writingMethod.articleIntegrationDesc: Input URLs of several articles to analyze and integrate their ideas, creating a new article with an improved structure.
writingMethod.overviewDesc: Create visually engaging list articles with rich keywords. Example titles like "10 Best...", suitable for guides and recommendations.
writingMethod.howToDesc: Create step-by-step operational instructions. Uses concise language and clear hierarchy, ideal for solving practical problems.
writingMethod.comparisonDesc: Analyze similarities and differences between two products or services. Lists pros and cons to help decision making.
writingMethod.explanatoryDesc: Provide detailed explanations of concepts or phenomena.
writingMethod.analyticalDesc: Deep dive analysis of data or trends.
